user.title: Set up Hakanban
user.description: This adds the Hakanban Kanban board to Home Assistant. There is nothing to configure — boards, columns and cards are managed from the Hakanban panel in the sidebar.

init.title: Link previews
init.description: Hakanban previews web links on cards by having Home Assistant fetch the page. It only fetches public sites, so it can't be used to probe your network. List the hosts on your own network it may fetch too.

data.preview_hosts: Hosts on your network to preview

data_description.preview_hosts: One per line (or comma-separated): a hostname (gitea.lan), a wildcard for its subdomains (*.home.example), an IP address or a network (192.168.1.0/24). Leave empty to preview public sites only.
